name: FinTradeBench
description: FinTradeBench evaluates LLM financial reasoning by combining fundamental analysis inputs (company financials, news) with quantitative trading signals. A key finding is that retrieval-augmented generation helps fundamental analysis tasks but does not improve time-series numerical reasoning, highlighting a persistent weakness of LLMs with raw numerical data.
reputation: Recent benchmark addressing the gap between qualitative financial reasoning and quantitative time-series forecasting in LLMs.
notes: Key finding: RAG helps fundamental analysis but not time-series numerical reasoning — LLMs struggle with raw numerical time-series data regardless of context augmentation. Consistent with broader evidence that LLMs lack numerical intuition.
